title: After-School Enrollment Checklist
subtitle: Capture dismissal route, weekly schedule, program capacity, and snack plan; confirm late pickup and classroom handoff.
description: After School Enrollment records dismissal route, weekly schedule, program capacity, snack plan, late pickup, and classroom handoff. After School Enrollment evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this after school enrollment stage-gated verification when staff must document dismissal route and weekly schedule. Reconcile program capacity, snack plan, late pickup, and classroom handoff before the after school enrollment handoff. Useful evidence includes the enrollment request, bell schedule, weekly roster, pickup authorization, snack-plan reference, and late-pickup contact log. Ask the assigned after school enrollment reviewer to confirm dismissal route against the organization's policy.

sections.title: After School Enrollment contact and reference
sections.guidance: Record bell-to-program transfer, selected weekdays, dismissal method, authorized pickup adults, snack routing, and late-pickup escalation.

blocks.label: After School Enrollment people and reference

sections.title: After School Enrollment checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current after school enrollment facts at point of use.

blocks.label: After School Enrollment required checks
items: Dismissal route is identified for this record
Weekly schedule matches the current request or source
Program capacity is ready for point-of-use staff
Snack plan limits or questions are resolved
Late pickup is communicated to the responsible person
Classroom handoff is confirmed at handoff
